build_pip_package: build a pip package for the StreetLearn library with setuptools setup configuration
find_files_matching: find all files matching a glob pattern recursively under a given root directory
filter_non_python_files: filter out Python files from a list of files to include only non-Python assets
collect_package_data: collect headers, external files, and shared object libraries for inclusion in the package
configure_setup_metadata: configure setuptools metadata including name, version, dependencies, and classifiers
